Google'dan aldığımız hesap bilgilerini s: We do not sell account information obtained from Google or use it for ad targeting or AI model training. Arama sonuçları hız ve tekrar kullanım i: Search results may be cached in server memory for up to six hours for speed and reuse. Tema, dil ve platform filtresi tercihler: Browser storage holds theme, language, and platform-filter preferences; films saved while signed out; account-list caches; and changes waiting to synchronize. Account-list caches are separated by user. Firebase sign-in sessions may also be stored in the browser. These records are removed or updated when you change the relevant preference, remove saved films, or clear browser/site data. You can end your sign-in session by signing out on the account page.
Çıkış yapmak veya hesabın bulut kayıtlar: Signing out or deleting cloud account records does not automatically clear every old cache on this device. On shared devices, clear filminibul.com site data to remove local copies too. Clearing changes that have not yet synchronized to the cloud may cause those changes to be lost.
Siteyi ve harici içerikleri yüklerken IP: When loading the site and external content, hosting and relevant service providers may process technical data such as IP address, browser information, request time, and requested address. The description search uses IP addresses in server memory to limit excessive use; this check is not associated with a membership profile. The no-IP-storage statement for product statistics does not mean service providers generate no technical connection records.
Siteyle iletişim HTTPS üzerinden sağlanı: Communication with the site uses HTTPS. Cloud lists are not public, and access is limited to the account verified by the server. Only authorized service administrators access records needed to handle support or deletion requests. Retention of service-provider technical logs and backups is governed by their own terms.
Google / Firebase Authentication: Google: Google / Firebase Authentication manages Google sign-in, account identity, and sessions, and stores basic profile information received from Google. Supabase stores private account-linked film lists and product usage statistics. Vercel hosts the application, runs server requests, processes technical connection data, and provides visit statistics through Vercel Analytics. These services process the data they receive to provide their respective functions.
OpenAI: “Tarif et” metni ve ondan türeti: OpenAI processes description-search text and derived search content. TMDB provides film information, title searches when needed, and directly loaded posters. JustWatch, through TMDB, provides Turkish streaming availability. YouTube loads trailers through youtube-nocookie.com when opened. Connecting to this content may allow the relevant provider to process technical connection information.
Google AdSense: sitede reklam kodu yükle: Google AdSense advertising code is loaded on the site; Google may use cookies and similar technologies for its advertising service. Our application does not send your Google sign-in profile or cloud film list to AdSense for ad personalization. Our Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control handling for product statistics does not automatically stop processing by every third-party service. These services' own privacy notices also apply.

Firebase üyelik kaydı ve temel profil bi: Your Firebase membership record and basic profile information are retained while your account exists. Cloud film records remain until you remove the film or a verified list/account deletion request is fulfilled. Inactive accounts and lists are not currently deleted on an automatic schedule. Browser copies and product statistics have the separate retention rules described above.

Kaydettiğin filmleri “Kaydettiklerim” sa: You can view and remove saved films individually on the watchlist page. A removal made while disconnected stays pending on the device until it reaches the cloud. Your name and email address are visible on the account page.
Hesabının, bulut film listesinin veya he: You can request deletion of your account, cloud film list, or both, or request information about your data, by emailing admin@filminibul.com. Please write from the email address used for your account and specify whether you want the account, the list, or both deleted so we can identify the relevant account. After account ownership is verified, an authorized administrator processes the request. We do not ask for your password or sign-in codes.
Hesap ve liste birlikte silindiğinde Fir: When the account and list are deleted together, the Firebase membership record and active Supabase film records associated with the account are removed. If you request only list deletion, your sign-in account is retained. We will tell you the outcome of the request. Remove local copies on your own devices separately by clearing site data. Daily statistical summaries that are not linked to accounts cannot be separated by individual user when an account is deleted.
Google hesabındaki üçüncü taraf bağlantı: You can remove Filminibul's Google sign-in connection in your Google account's third-party connections. This does not by itself delete membership or film-list data already stored in Filminibul; use the request process above to delete those records. Signing out is also not account deletion.
Gizlilik soruları, hesap/veri silme ve v: Contact admin@filminibul.com for privacy questions, account/data deletion, and requests to access your data.
